name: Aasimar
description: Mortals carrying a spark of the Upper Planes: light, healing, resistance, and a revelation that blooms later.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: Resist Radiant and Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: Once per Long Rest, heal a creature with a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: Know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description: At level 3, reveal celestial power in one of several forms.

name: Dragonborn
description: Proud heirs of draconic power, carrying an elemental breath and matching resistance.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose the dragon ancestry that determines your breath weapon damage and resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Replace one attack with a breath weapon. Save DC is 8 + CON modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: Resist the damage type tied to your draconic ancestry.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: At level 5, briefly manifest spectral wings.

name: Dwarf
description: Hardy folk of stone, craft, endurance, and absolutely unreasonable staying power.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resist Poison damage and gain advantage against the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 per character level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Briefly gain Tremorsense while on or touching stone.

name: Elf
description: Fey-touched people with keen senses, trance, charm resistance, and a magical lineage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf for your level 1 lineage benefit.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You do not need sleep and can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trance.

options.name: Drow
options.description: Darkvision extends to 120 feet and you know Dancing Lights.

options.name: High Elf
options.description: You know Prestidigitation and can later refresh your cantrip after Long Rests.

options.name: Wood Elf
options.description: Your Speed increases to 35 feet and you know Druidcraft.

name: Gnome
description: Small magical folk with sharp minds, uncanny defenses, and a chosen lineage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome for your level 1 magic.

options.name: Forest Gnome
options.description: You know Minor Illusion and can cast Speak with Animals through this trait.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.description: You know Mending and Prestidigitation, and can create tiny clockwork devices.

name: Goliath
description: Large-framed descendants of giants with a supernatural ancestry boon.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a giant-linked boon usable a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: At level 5, briefly become Large and gain movement and Strength-check benefits.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: Advantage to end Grappled and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

options.name: Cloud's Jaunt
options.description: Teleport up to 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Fire's Burn
options.description: Add 1d10 Fire damage after hitting with an attack.

options.name: Frost's Chill
options.description: Add 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target's Speed briefly.

options.name: Hill's Tumble
options.description: Knock a Large or smaller target Prone after hitting it.

options.name: Stone's Endurance
options.description: React to reduce incoming damage by 1d12 + CON modifier.

options.name: Storm's Thunder
options.description: React to damage a nearby creature with Thunder damage.

name: Halfling
description: Small, brave, lucky adventurers who keep finding unlikely gaps in very large problems.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: Move through the space of creatures larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: Reroll a 1 on a d20 Test and use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can Hide while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

name: Human
description: Adaptable people found almost anywhere, known for versatility and nerve.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.

name: Orc
description: Powerful, relentless wanderers with endurance, determination, and speed when danger gets pushy.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: Dash as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: Once per Long Rest, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 when not killed outright.

name: Tiefling
description: People touched by the Lower Planes, with a chosen fiendish legacy and absolutely no obligation to be dramatic about it.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: See in dim light and darkness out to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal for your resistance and level 1 cantrip.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: Know Thaumaturgy using the same spellcasting ability as your legacy.
